title: Sea of Stars
description: Turn-based RPG in the Chrono Trigger tradition from Sabotage. Two Children of the Solstice combine sun and moon into Eclipse Magic to fight the Fleshmancer's creations.

title: Granblue Fantasy: Relink
description: Cygames' action RPG spin on the Granblue universe. A four-skyfarer party carves through set-piece quests, solo or in co-op, with a big roster to swap between.

title: Unicorn Overlord
description: Vanillaware tactical RPG in which exiled prince Alain rebuilds the Liberation Army to retake the continent of Fevrith from the Zenoiran Empire. Squads of up to five units fight in auto-resolved battles driven by preset tactics, with real-time movement on an overworld map.
notes: console only, vanillaware says no pc port planned. also on ps4.

title: Avowed
description: Obsidian's first-person fantasy RPG in the Pillars of Eternity world of Eora. An envoy of Aedyr is sent to the Living Lands to investigate a spreading plague, with magic-and-steel combat and choice-driven companions.

title: The Séance of Blake Manor
description: Supernatural detective mystery set in an 1897 Irish hotel. Investigate the disappearance of Evelyn Deane over a fixed handful of days as the manor's secrets and séances unfold.

title: Tales of Xillia Remastered
description: First remaster of the 2011 Tales entry. Play Rieze Maxia from either Jude Mathis or Milla Maxwell's side, with the usual quality-of-life passes and all DLC bundled.

title: Mina the Hollower
description: Yacht Club's Game Boy Color-styled action adventure. Mina, a renowned Hollower, whips and burrows her way across a cursed island in a top-down Zelda-meets-Castlevania mould.

title: Star Wars Zero Company
description: Turn-based tactics in the Clone Wars from Bit Reactor (ex-XCOM devs) and Respawn. Former Republic officer Hawks leads the mercenary outfit Zero Company against an emerging threat called the Infinite Coil.

title: The Blood of Dawnwalker
description: Dark-fantasy action RPG from Rebel Wolves (ex-Witcher 3 leads). Coen, half-human by day and vampire by night, has 30 days in a vampire-ruled 14th-century Carpathian valley to rescue his family from the lord Brencis.

title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
description: Capcom's return to Onimusha. Miyamoto Musashi, sent back from Hell with the Oni Gauntlet, cuts through Genma demons in a supernatural Kyoto to stop a gate to Hell from opening.

title: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave
description: Tactical RPG set in the Dagdan Empire, in the same universe as Three Houses. Four heroes compete in the Heroic Games across past and present to earn a wish and stop the demon god Balor.

title: Control: Resonant
description: Remedy's sequel to Control, now an action RPG. Dylan Faden is released from Bureau custody to hunt an escaped paranatural entity through a warped Manhattan, and to find his sister Jesse.
notes: physical edition slips to oct 15; digital is the 24th.

title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer
description: Podracing revival set in the New Republic era. Compete in the Galactic League across multiple planets, with a roguelite-structured single-player campaign that branches on how you race.

title: Valor Mortis
description: First-person soulslike from the Ghostrunner studio. William, a resurrected British soldier in an alternate 19th-century Europe ravaged by Napoleon's supernatural plague, fights his undead former comrades and digs into why he came back.
notes: slipped from sep 24 to oct 13 for polish.

title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
description: Side-scrolling metroidvania from Evil Empire (Dead Cells) for the series' 40th anniversary. Rose Belmont, daughter of Trevor, whips her way into a castle that has manifested in 1499 Paris.

title: Phantom Blade Zero
description: Kung-fu action game steeped in wuxia and folk horror. Soul, an assassin with sixty-six days left to live, fends off rival killers and unravels a world-ending conspiracy across a dark, mechanical fantasy world.
notes: pushed 50 days from sep 9; console side is ps5-only for a year.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
description: Ground-up remake of the 1998 original: overhauled visuals, voiced cutscenes, orchestral score, full camera control, a dash, a real jump button, and expanded areas to explore.

title: Metroid Ravenous
description: New 2D Metroid from MercurySteam and Nintendo EPD. Samus is ambushed and marooned on an unfamiliar moon, gravely injured, and must use newly awakened Metroid instincts to devour her enemies to survive and get home.

title: Persona 4 Revival
description: Ground-up remake of Persona 4 Golden. Same Inaba murder mystery and cast, rebuilt with the systems and presentation of the later Persona games.

title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation
description: Final chapter of the FFVII Remake trilogy, picking up right after Rebirth. Cloud and AVALANCHE push on to the Northern Crater to confront Sephiroth and see the original's ending through.
notes: all platforms day one this time, no ps5 exclusivity window.

title: Persona 6
description: Next mainline Persona, revealed at the June 2026 Xbox showcase and the first without director Katsura Hashino. Little is confirmed beyond a teaser; leaks point to a graveyard motif and a green palette.
notes: atlus says it lands after p4 revival (feb 2027); leakers say sep 2027. no official date.
